strategy.fails_on_buggy: The new assertion sees (-O).y == -1 while O.y == 1, so the equality check is False and pytest reports AssertionError on the negation line, because __neg__ computes -self.y - a1*self.x - a3 and yields the non-canonical (0, -1, 0).
strategy.passes_on_fixed: With the early return of point_at_infinity(self._curve) when self.z == 0, (-O).x, (-O).y, (-O).z equal (0, 1, 0) matching O, so all assertions in test_elliptic_curve pass.
